construct: Autoantibodies against presynaptic P/Q-type voltage-gated calcium channels reduce calcium entry into motor nerve terminals and decrease acetylcholine release. Repetitive activation can transiently increase calcium accumulation and improve strength.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Proximal weakness, dry mouth, hyporeflexia, facilitation with repeated activation, and small-cell lung carcinoma identifies Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome, a presynaptic P/Q-type voltage-gated calcium-channel autoimmune disorder.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Myasthenia gravis is the strongest neuromuscular-junction alternative, but autonomic symptoms, hyporeflexia, exercise facilitation, and SCLC strongly favor LEMS. Botulism is acute toxic disease; polymyositis and ALS lack the presynaptic facilitation pattern.
